init_ascend_gdn_backend: initialize an AscendGDNAttnBackend instance with a ModelRunner to set up the GDN kernel dispatcher
prepare_gdn_inputs: prepare GDN input tensors including num_accepted_tokens and ssm_state_indices for a given forward mode
forward_decode_gdn: run the GDN decode forward pass with causal conv1d update and kernel dispatcher decode on NPU
forward_extend_gdn: run the GDN extend forward pass with causal conv1d and fused gating for prefill or target verify
fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule_update: execute the fused recurrent gated delta rule update operation via torch.ops.npu for speculative decoding
